subject: planner: improve OptimizationFlags to avoid internal sql's syncload (#61401)
summary: Reviewed diff in `pkg/planner/core/optimizer.go` and `pkg/planner/core/rule_collect_plan_stats.go`: stats-collection and sync-wait stats-load optimization points are now enabled only when `!SessionVars.InRestrictedSQL`, and the rules assert (via `intest.Assert`) they are never invoked under restricted SQL. No plausible Blocker/High issues found in planner correctness/semantics/session behavior within this change.
